title: Travelling Through the Snow Queen's Kingdom
statementMd:
Gerda is travelling to the palace of the Snow Queen.

The road network consists of $*n*$ intersections and $*m*$ bidirectional roads. Roads are numbered from $1$ to $*m*$. Snow Queen put a powerful spell on the roads to change the weather conditions there. Now, if Gerda steps on the road $*i*$ at the moment of time less or equal to $*i*$, she will leave the road exactly at the moment $*i*$. In case she steps on the road $*i*$ at the moment of time greater than $*i*$, she stays there forever.

Gerda starts at the moment of time $*l*$ at the intersection number $*s*$ and goes to the palace of the Snow Queen, located at the intersection number $*t*$. Moreover, she has to be there at the moment $*r*$ (or earlier), before the arrival of the Queen.

Given the description of the road network, determine for $*q*$ queries $*l*_{*i*}$, $*r*_{*i*}$, $*s*_{*i*}$ and $*t*_{*i*}$ if it's possible for Gerda to get to the palace on time.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*q*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$, $1 ≤ *m*, *q* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of intersections in the road network of Snow Queen's Kingdom, the number of roads and the number of queries you have to answer.

The $*i*$-th of the following $*m*$ lines contains the description of the road number $*i*$. The description consists of two integers $*v*_{*i*}$ and $*u*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *v*_{*i*}, *u*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*v*_{*i*} ≠ *u*_{*i*}$) — the indices of the intersections connected by the $*i*$-th road. It's possible to get both from $*v*_{*i*}$ to $*u*_{*i*}$ and from $*u*_{*i*}$ to $*v*_{*i*}$ using only this road. Each pair of intersection may appear several times, meaning there are several roads connecting this pair.

Last $*q*$ lines contain the queries descriptions. Each of them consists of four integers $*l*_{*i*}$, $*r*_{*i*}$, $*s*_{*i*}$ and $*t*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$, $1 ≤ *s*_{*i*}, *t*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*s*_{*i*} ≠ *t*_{*i*}$) — the moment of time Gerda starts her journey, the last moment of time she is allowed to arrive to the palace, the index of the starting intersection and the index of the intersection where palace is located.

## Output

For each query print "`Yes`" (without quotes) if Gerda can be at the Snow Queen palace on time (not later than $*r*_{*i*}$) or "`No`" (without quotes) otherwise.
statementZhMd:
格尔达正在前往冰雪女王的宫殿。

道路网络由 $*n*$ 个交叉路口和 $*m*$ 条双向道路组成。道路编号从 $1$ 到 $*m*$。冰雪女王对道路施加了强大的魔法，改变了道路上的天气状况。现在，如果格尔达在时刻小于或等于 $*i*$ 时踏上道路 $*i*$，她将在恰好时刻 $*i*$ 离开这条道路。如果她在时刻大于 $*i*$ 时踏上道路 $*i*$，她将永远停留在那里。

格尔达在时刻 $*l*$ 从编号为 $*s*$ 的交叉路口出发，前往位于编号为 $*t*$ 的交叉路口的冰雪女王宫殿。此外，她必须在时刻 $*r*$（或更早）抵达那里，即在女王到来之前到达。

给定道路网络的描述，对于 $*q*$ 个询问 $*l*_{*i*}$、$*r*_{*i*}$、$*s*_{*i*}$ 和 $*t*_{*i*}$，判断格尔达是否能够按时抵达宫殿。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*q*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$，$1 ≤ *m*, *q* ≤ 200 000$），分别表示冰雪女王王国中交叉路口的数量、道路的数量以及需要回答的询问数量。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，第 $*i*$ 行包含编号为 $*i*$ 的道路的描述。描述由两个整数 $*v*_{*i*}$ 和 $*u*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *v*_{*i*}, *u*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*v*_{*i*} ≠ *u*_{*i*}$）组成，表示由第 $*i*$ 条道路连接的两个交叉路口的编号。仅使用这条道路，可以从 $*v*_{*i*}$ 到达 $*u*_{*i*}$，也可以从 $*u*_{*i*}$ 到达 $*v*_{*i*}$。同一对交叉路口可能出现多次，这意味着它们之间存在多条道路。

最后 $*q*$ 行包含询问的描述。每个询问由四个整数 $*l*_{*i*}$、$*r*_{*i*}$、$*s*_{*i*}$ 和 $*t*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$，$1 ≤ *s*_{*i*}, *t*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*s*_{*i*} ≠ *t*_{*i*}$）组成，分别表示格尔达开始旅程的时刻、她最晚允许抵达宫殿的时刻、起始交叉路口的编号以及宫殿所在交叉路口的编号。

## 输出格式

对于每个询问，如果格尔达能够按时（不晚于 $*r*_{*i*}$）抵达冰雪女王的宫殿，则输出 `Yes`（不含引号）；否则输出 `No`（不含引号）。
